upperthong.name: Upperthong

rival.intro: Dave has a boot on each hand, a flat cap on his head and no plans to lose to a person from Cheshire.
rival.beaten: Dave takes the news like a man who has lost a boot in a hedge. Which, in fairness, he has done.

upperthong.real: The real thing is welly wanging at Upperthong, near Holmfirth in West Yorkshire, a village competition that draws a good crowd and a great many borrowed boots. To wang is Northern for to throw.

how: Hold Confirm to spin the boot round your head. The faster it goes the further it flies, but go too fast and you get dizzy and wild. Let go as the boot passes the marked gap in the swing, about forty degrees up, and mind the flag: a tail wind helps and a head wind does not. Three goes, best counts.
